{"id":1501749986,"question_id":3309,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1736335419,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"7 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1501749986/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Prefix and Suffix Pairs I","memory":"24.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool isPrefixAndSuffix(string a , string b){\n        int s1 = a.length();\n        int s2 = b.length();\n        if(s1>s2)\n        {\n            return false;\n        }\n        string prefix = b.substr(0,s1);\n        string suffix = b.substr(s2-s1);\n\n        if(prefix == a && suffix == a)\n        {\n            return true;\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    int countPrefixSuffixPairs(vector<string>& words) {\n        int n = words.size();\n        int count = 0;\n        for(int i=0; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j =i+1; j<=n-1 ; j++)\n            {\n                string str1= words[i];\n                string str2= words[j];\n\n                if(isPrefixAndSuffix(str1,str2))\n                {\n                    ++count ;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return count ;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-prefix-and-suffix-pairs-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":122}
